title: Keep focus after closing the command palette

messages.text: Closing the command palette sometimes leaves focus nowhere, so the next keystroke does nothing. Please keep focus on the previous editor target.
I’ll inspect how the palette saves and restores focus.

tools.name: read
tools.label: Read palette close path
tools.output: The close path clears palette focus but only restores the editor after a command executes.

messages.text: Esc should work the same way as choosing a command, without moving focus if a modal had it first.
I’ll restore the stored target only when the palette owns focus and preserve modal precedence.

tools.name: patch
tools.label: Restore saved focus on palette cancel
tools.output: Esc and command completion now use the shared focus return helper.

messages.text: Add explicit tests for Esc and modal precedence.
The behavior is covered and the keyboard navigation note was checked for consistency.
